description: This file contains auto-generated C# code defining serializers, copiers, and codecs for Protocol Buffers serialization within the Orleans framework. It includes classes for handling ByteString, MapField, RepeatedField, and a general ProtobufCodec, along with their associated copier classes and extension methods.
